papers.title: Metabolite-centric Knowledge Graph Unveils Predictive and Mechanistic Insights through Self-supervised Multimodal Learning
papers.abstract: Metabolomics research is advancing toward a comprehensive view of metabolites and their biological functions, yet conventional, dictionary-like databases fall short of presenting these complexities. To overcome this limitation, we developed MetaKG, a metabolite-centric knowledge graph that integrates diverse chemical, biological, and semantic data, coupled with a global self-supervised multimodal learning framework that generates advanced embeddings (MetaKGE) for both predictive and mechanistic analyses. MetaKG outperforms existing models in standard representation learning metrics and across 12 external datasets. Furthermore, MetaKG refines existing database information by detecting misannotated labels and uncovering previously overlooked biochemical relationships. Its predictive capability naturally yields testable biochemical hypotheses, as demonstrated in studies of G6PD deficiency and colorectal cancer. By transforming passive, database-scale information into extractable knowledge and actionable insights, MetaKG paves the way for hypothesis-driven discovery in metabolomics and holds promise for informing future research in clinical biomarker identification and therapeutic development.

summary.takeaway: 本文提出以代谢物为中心的知识图谱 MetaKG，并结合自监督多模态学习生成嵌入 MetaKGE，用于预测与机制分析。
summary.methods: 整合化学、生物学与语义数据构建知识图谱，采用全局自监督多模态学习框架生成嵌入；在标准表示学习指标和 12 个外部数据集上评估，并以 G6PD 缺乏症和结直肠癌为案例进行分析。
summary.relevance: 与知识图谱、自监督与表示学习、多模态学习三个主题直接相关，展示了多源异构数据融合与自监督嵌入在生物医学知识发现中的应用。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅给出定性结论（优于现有模型、检测到错误标注），未提供具体性能数值；案例结果属于可检验假设，摘要未说明实验验证程度。

papers.title: Genetic Perturbation Prediction Models Fail Out-of-Distribution: A Rigorous Benchmark and Systematic Evaluation
papers.abstract: Perturbation prediction models - which forecast transcriptional responses to gene inactivation - are increasingly proposed as in silico surrogates for genome-scale drug discovery screens. Yet, rigorous evaluation of whether these models genuinely generalize beyond their training distribution has been lacking. Existing benchmarks rely predominantly on random train-test splits, obscuring systematic failure modes that only emerge under realistic out-of-distribution (OOD) conditions. Here we introduce EL-PERTURB (Extrapolative Learning for PERTURBation Prediction), a benchmarking framework that stress-tests 20 perturbation prediction models spanning six architecture classes on both essential gene and genome-wide Perturb-seq screens, using a novel stratified OOD splitting strategy that partitions train and test sets into functionally distinct regions of transcriptional space. We find that model performance degrades substantially under OOD conditions, and that architectural complexity - including single-cell foundation model embeddings - confers no reliable advantage over well-tuned simpler baselines. EL-PERTURB establishes a rigorous benchmark for perturbation effect prediction across a gradient of generalization difficulty, providing a guide for building models that can genuinely serve as surrogates for wet-lab screening.

summary.takeaway: 作者提出 EL-PERTURB 基准，发现 20 个扰动预测模型在分布外条件下性能显著下降，架构复杂度（含单细胞基础模型嵌入）并未带来可靠优势。
summary.methods: 构建分层 OOD 划分策略，将训练与测试集分到转录空间的功能不同区域；在必需基因和全基因组 Perturb-seq 数据上评测六大架构类别的 20 个模型，并与调优后的简单基线比较。
summary.relevance: 直接针对单细胞扰动预测的泛化评估，涉及 Cell Foundation Model 与预训练表征是否真正有助于跨分布泛化这一核心问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告具体性能数值；OOD 划分策略的设计选择可能影响结论的普适性，摘要未讨论该策略自身的敏感性。

papers.title: scRBP infers cell-specific RNA-binding protein regulons from single-cell transcriptomes at gene and isoform resolution
papers.abstract: Single-cell regulatory network inference remains dominated by transcription factors, despite RNA-binding proteins (RBPs) orchestrating major aspects of transcriptional regulation. We present scRBP, a framework that infers motif-supported RBP regulons from short- and long-read single-cell transcriptomes at gene and isoform resolution, resolves targets by transcript region (5'UTR, CDS, intron, 3'UTR), scores regulon activity in individual cells, and tests common- and rare-variant association against matched empirical nulls. From 20,746 motifs for 616 RBPs, scRBP recovered experimentally defined targets across 223 ENCODE eCLIP datasets at gene and isoform level. Across 30 tissues, transcript-region preferences separated 3'UTR-associated stability factors from intron-dominant splicing regulators. In published genome-scale CRISPRi Perturb-seq data, scRBP-inferred targets were over-represented among genes responding to RBP knockdown (1.4-2.5-fold across 161 RBPs; FDR<2x10-4). Across 6.2 million cells and 50 traits, scRBP prioritized cell-specific post-transcriptional programs linking human genetic risk to development and disease.

summary.takeaway: scRBP 从短读长与长读长单细胞转录组中推断受 motif 支持的 RBP regulon，实现基因与 isoform 分辨率的细胞特异性调控网络推断。
summary.methods: 基于 616 个 RBP 的 20,746 个 motif 推断 regulon，按转录区域（5'UTR、CDS、内含子、3'UTR）解析靶标并评分单细胞活性；用 223 个 ENCODE eCLIP 数据集验证，在 CRISPRi Perturb-seq 数据中检验靶标富集，并分析 6.2 百万细胞与 50 个性状的变异关联。
summary.relevance: 将调控网络推断从转录因子扩展到 RNA 结合蛋白，与 GRN/Regulon 和单细胞扰动主题相关，并可与扰动数据交叉验证。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告了富集倍数与 FDR，但未给出 regulon 推断的精确率等完整性能指标；变异关联分析为统计优先级排序，未提供功能验证。

papers.title: Auditing Confidence-Calibrated Benchmarking of Single-Cell Perturbation Models
papers.abstract: Single-cell perturbation models are increasingly assessed for both predictive performance and calibrated uncertainty under distribution shift. We constructed such an evaluation harness (two datasets, Norman 2019 and Replogle 2022; four split types over six dataset-split combinations; three models, scVI, CPA and a linear Ridge baseline; three uncertainty quantification methods, MC dropout, quantile regression and split conformal prediction) and then audited it against null baselines it had never included. Most of its headline results measure something other than what their metric names claim. The harness supplied each test cell to the model as input and then scored the model on reproducing that same cell's expression, so an identity predictor returning the input unchanged attains a perturbation-effect correlation of 1.0 on all six splits: any model given the target cell is measured against this echo ceiling rather than against a null. Against a constant train-mean predictor, scVI wins on 99.7% of Norman cells but only 0.2% of Replogle cells. One split held out sequencing batches rather than perturbations; another scores no genuinely novel perturbation after label collapse; unseen perturbations are silently replaced with a negative-control sentinel at inference; and the most convention-sensitive decision-value entry moves 29.2 percentage points under a library-size convention that changes that row's all-gene MSE by 0.01%. Because a validation budget is spent on a ranked shortlist rather than on a marginal interval, we also score each uncertainty signal by the DE-gene error it avoids in the top k: the worst-calibrated method is the best ranker, and a benchmark reporting only coverage orders the two backwards. We document six failure modes, each with its mechanism, the diagnostic that exposes it, and a detection procedure transferable to other harnesses. One result survives, with a boundary condition: split-conformal coverage calibrated on K562 residuals under-covers on RPE1 (0.900 to 0.847), and marginal coverage at the nominal 0.900 is compatible with covering 0.271 to 0.342 of the DE-gene intervals a prioritization decision would rest on. We continue to recommend conformal prediction, recalibrated per cellular context and reported per gene set rather than marginally.

summary.takeaway: 本文审计一个单细胞扰动模型评估框架，发现多数主要结果测量的是与指标名称不符的对象，并记录了六种失效模式及其诊断方法。
summary.methods: 使用 Norman 2019 与 Replogle 2022 两个数据集、四种划分共六种数据集-划分组合、三个模型（scVI、CPA、线性 Ridge 基线）和三种不确定性量化方法（MC dropout、分位数回归、split conformal），并加入此前缺失的零基线进行对照审计。
summary.relevance: 直接关系单细胞扰动模型的评估效度与不确定性校准，对扰动预测基准设计和 conformal prediction 的使用具有警示意义。
summary.caveat: 这是对特定评估框架的审计，结论的可推广性依赖于所审计框架的代表性；摘要中 split conformal 在 K562 校准后于 RPE1 欠覆盖的结果仍带边界条件。

papers.title: SADRP: A structurally aware multi-modal framework for drug response prediction.
papers.abstract: MOTIVATION: Predicting drug sensitivity across diverse cancer samples is a fundamental challenge in personalized therapy and drug discovery. This task requires comprehensive characterization of both drug and cancer cell line features. Current approaches often fail to fully capture the complex structural characteristics and interactions of drug compounds and struggle to integrate multi-omics features derived from the same sample, limiting their feature representation capacity. Consequently, there is a need for modeling frameworks that can jointly model molecular structural features and multi-modal cellular contexts in a unified manner. RESULTS: We present SADRP, a structurally aware multi-modal framework for drug response prediction, designed to model complex molecular structures and multi-omics data. For drug representation, SADRP incorporates Shortest Distance Path (SDP) encoding and edge encoding to capture both topological relationships and bond-type chemical semantics. For cell line profiling, a multi-view interactive encoder integrates gene expression and DNA methylation, capturing cross-omics synergistic complementarity. SADRP consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, while also identifying potential therapeutic candidates and biomarkers, providing mechanistic insights and supporting applications in drug discovery and personalized medicine.

summary.takeaway: SADRP 是结构感知的多模态药物反应预测框架，联合建模药物分子结构与细胞系多组学特征。
summary.methods: 药物表示引入最短距离路径（SDP）编码与边编码以刻画拓扑和键类型语义；细胞系侧采用多视图交互编码器整合基因表达与 DNA 甲基化；与现有方法比较并分析候选治疗物与生物标志物。
summary.relevance: 与药物扰动机制主题相关，提供从分子结构与多组学上下文预测药物敏感性的建模思路。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅称持续优于现有方法，未给出数据集、指标或具体数值；生物标志物与候选药物属计算预测，摘要未说明验证情况。

papers.title: Robust identification of cell-cell communication heterogeneity in single cells.
papers.abstract: Cell-cell communication modulates cell fate decisions by relaying information across tissues and inducing intracellular responses mediated by gene regulatory networks. Although the inference of cell-cell communication from high-throughput data is gaining popularity, studying how communication pathways operate across biological scales and influence cell fate decisions remains challenging. Here, we present scRICH (robust identification of cell-cell communication heterogeneity in single cells), a computational framework that leverages single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data to unravel the heterogeneity of communication behavior within cell types, link cell-cell communication to cell fate decisions by incorporating dynamical information on RNA splicing, and connect cell-cell interactions with intracellular responses by constructing multilayer regulatory networks. We validate scRICH with new experiments on epidermal growth factor (EGF) ligand/receptor co-expression in keratinocytes, comparing these predictions against those of existing communication inference methods. Applying scRICH to multiple biological scenarios demonstrates its ability to capture relationships between distinct communication pathways and emerging trends along cell differentiation lineages and in space. A record of this paper's transparent peer review process is included in the supplemental information.

summary.takeaway: scRICH 是推断单细胞通讯异质性的计算框架，将细胞间通讯与细胞内调控网络及细胞命运决定联系起来。
summary.methods: 利用单细胞与空间转录组数据刻画细胞类型内通讯行为异质性，结合 RNA 剪接动态信息关联通讯与命运决定，构建多层调控网络连接细胞间互作与胞内响应；以角质形成细胞中 EGF 配体/受体共表达的新实验进行验证。
summary.relevance: 连接细胞间通讯与 GRN/Regulon 及多层调控网络，与调控网络推断主题相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出与现有通讯推断方法比较的定量结果，仅提到进行了对比；验证集中于 EGF 一个案例，其他场景为应用展示。

papers.title: A synthetic MALDI-TOF MS atlas for microbial classification across hospitals
papers.abstract: Matrix-Assisted Laser Desorption/Ionization Time-of-Flight (MALDI-TOF) mass spectrometry (MS) is central to routine clinical microbiology for species identification. Its combination with machine learning is constrained by fragmented public datasets, species imbalance and acquisition-related variability. Synthetic datasets could provide more training data, but they must preserve the spectral information needed to make predictions on real samples. Here, we present an open, synthetic MALDI-TOF MS atlas comprising 4.3 million spectra across 43 clinically relevant bacterial species. To construct the atlas, we harmonised public repositories from three countries and trained a species- and institution-conditioned concept-bottleneck generative variational autoencoder (CBGM-VAE) on 179,086 measured spectra. We assessed the atlas as both a stand-alone training resource and a complement to real data, using bacterial species classification as a functional benchmark. Evaluation comprised 7,269 real spectra from more than 7 countries, 24 institutions and multiple acquisition platforms, covering: temporal, technical, biological and combined shifts. A neural network trained only on synthetic spectra achieved F1 scores ranging from 0.788 to 1.000 across external cohorts. When synthetic spectra were combined with real training data, classification performance improved or matched using real data only. These findings demonstrate that the atlas retains transferable information and can complement measured data. The openly released atlas provides a reusable resource for supervised learning and benchmarking. It can also be explored for pretraining representation-learning and foundation models in MALDI-TOF MS research.

summary.takeaway: 本文发布覆盖 43 种临床相关细菌、430 万条谱图的公开合成 MALDI-TOF MS 图谱库，并证明仅用合成数据训练的模型可在外部队列中分类。
summary.methods: 整合三国公共数据库的 179,086 条实测谱图，训练物种与机构条件化的概念瓶颈生成变分自编码器（CBGM-VAE）生成合成谱图；以物种分类为功能基准，在来自 7 国以上、24 家机构、多平台的 7,269 条实测谱图上评估时间、技术、生物学及复合偏移。
summary.relevance: 涉及合成数据、预训练与跨机构泛化，与预训练及检索增强/对齐主题中的分布偏移问题相关。
summary.caveat: 评估限于细菌物种分类这一功能基准；摘要仅给出合成数据单独训练的 F1 范围 0.788–1.000，未报告各偏移类型下的细分结果。

papers.title: DCAF: Unifying Data Validity, Evaluation Validity and Predictive Modeling for Single-cell Perturbation Simulation
papers.abstract: Single-cell perturbation profiling is limited by cost and throughput, while computational methods remain constrained by inconsistent evaluation and underperformance relative to simple baselines. Here we present DCAF, a unified framework for single-cell perturbation simulation that that jointly addresses data validity, evaluation validity and predictive modeling. Among its three components, DCAF-data addresses the single-measurement limitation by reconstructing pre- and post-perturbation status using entropy-regularized optimal transport, and is demonstrated on both cell line and multi-cell type datasets. DCAF-criterion evaluates log fold changes in non-silenced genes to improve sensitivity to model error and robustness to zero inflation noise, validated on synthetic datasets. DCAF-model combines JEPA with explicit modeling for regulatory-dynamics modeling for interpretable prediction. Across benchmarks, DCAF outperforms state-of-the-art deep-learning methods, as well as mean and linear baselines in cross-gene, cross-cell-type and cross-region generalization. In adult Mouse brain, DCAF recapitulates known cell-type-specific regulatory heterogeneity of Dgcr8 knockdown at both cell type and gene levels. DCAF thus provides a rigorous and biologically grounded foundation for reliable perturbation simulation across development, disease and therapeutic discovery.

summary.takeaway: DCAF 是统一数据有效性、评估有效性与预测建模的单细胞扰动模拟框架，在跨基因、跨细胞类型和跨区域泛化上优于现有深度学习方法及均值、线性基线。
summary.methods: DCAF-data 用熵正则最优传输重建扰动前后状态；DCAF-criterion 基于非沉默基因的 log fold change 改进评估灵敏度与零膨胀鲁棒性；DCAF-model 结合 JEPA 与显式调控动态建模；在细胞系与多细胞类型数据上验证，并在成年小鼠脑中复现 Dgcr8 敲低的细胞类型特异性调控异质性。
summary.relevance: 直接面向单细胞扰动预测与评估有效性，与单细胞扰动主题高度契合。
summary.caveat: 摘要给出定性优势结论但无量化的基准数值；小鼠脑结果为对已知调控异质性的复现，并非新发现验证。

papers.title: Determinants of cysteine coverage by chemoproteomics
papers.abstract: Covalent chemoproteomics has become a powerful route to expanding the druggable proteome, enabling proteome-wide screening of compounds that covalently modify nucleophilic residues, most commonly cysteine. Yet typical experiments detect only 5-18% of the ~250,000 cysteines encoded by the human proteome, and the determinants of this limited coverage remain poorlydefined. Here we combine cysteine featurisation, explainable machine learning (ML) and robust statistical filtering to establish what governs cysteine detectability in iodoacetamide- desthiobiotin (IA-DTB) chemoproteomics. Using a scalable feature-generation pipeline, we computed physicochemical and structural properties for cysteines and the corresponding tryptic peptides and trained models that predict detectability with high accuracy. Shapley analysis identifies protein abundance and intrinsic peptide properties governing LC-MS behaviour as the dominant determinants, whereas cysteine structural descriptors contribute comparatively little, indicating that detection is constrained downstream of probe reactivity. We further introduce a distance-based statistical filter that improves reproducibility across replicates, and show that cell line selection, subcellular fractionation and alternative electrophiles together expand coverage by >30%. More broadly, this work moves optimisation of chemoproteomics workflows from empirical trial-and-error towards rational, data-driven design.

summary.takeaway: 该研究通过可解释机器学习与统计过滤，揭示了IA-DTB化学蛋白质组学中半胱氨酸可检测性的主导因素：蛋白丰度与肽段LC-MS内在性质，而非半胱氨酸结构特征。
summary.methods: 对半胱氨酸及其胰酶肽段构建可扩展特征生成流程，计算理化与结构属性，训练可检测性预测模型，并用Shapley分析归因；引入基于距离的统计过滤提升重复间可重复性，并比较细胞系、亚细胞分级与替代亲电试剂对覆盖度的影响。
summary.relevance: 文章涉及特征工程、可解释机器学习与模型归因分析，与检索增强与对齐主题中模型可解释性及数据驱动流程优化相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告覆盖度提升大于30%的定性结论，未给出具体数值与统计细节；结论限于IA-DTB体系，是否泛化到其他探针或组织尚未说明。

papers.title: TiSAM: fusing spatial and histopathology foundation models for whole-slide image segmentation
papers.abstract: Semantic segmentation of whole-slide images (WSIs) quantifies tissue composition and architecture, but existing models require extensive annotation and lose accuracy as the number of tissue classes increases or on heterogeneous, cross-scanner datasets. Here, we present the Tissue Segment Anything Model (TiSAM), which fuses SAM3 spatial features with UNI2-h pathology features within a multi-scale decoder. Because public benchmarks contain few tissue classes, we release MegaMouse, comprising 36,833 annotations of 52 tissue classes from 12 mouse organs, and an 11-class human pancreas dataset. TiSAM achieved the highest overall performance across four public datasets compared to existing convolutional neural network and vision transformer models, maintained high accuracy on MegaMouse, and maintained high accuracy in the human pancreas dataset when trained on as few as 5 annotated WSIs where previous integrations of SAM with pathology foundation models did not. TiSAM segmentations were also more consistent across eight slide scanners compared to other models. These results establish TiSAM as a general and highly adaptable framework for tissue segmentation, enabling studies containing many tissue classes, limited annotations, or images from multiple scanners.

summary.takeaway: TiSAM融合SAM3空间特征与UNI2-h病理基础模型特征，在多尺度解码器中实现整张切片组织分割，并在多类别、少标注与跨扫描仪场景下表现稳健。
summary.methods: 将SAM3与UNI2-h特征在多尺度解码器内融合；发布MegaMouse数据集（12个小鼠器官、52类组织、36,833条标注）及11类人胰腺数据集；在四个公开数据集及新数据集上与传统CNN和ViT模型比较，并测试仅用5张标注WSI训练及八种扫描仪一致性。
summary.relevance: 该工作属于预训练基础模型（SAM、病理基础模型）的特征融合与下游适配，契合预训练主题中的多模态特征整合与标注效率问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要为作者自述结果，缺少具体指标数值与统计检验；在跨物种、跨器官及更多组织类别上的泛化性仍需外部验证。

papers.title: Stain Normalisation Does Not Consistently Improve Matched-Location Retrieval with Pathology Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Pathology foundation models provide reusable representations for computational pathology, but staining- and scanner-induced variation may compromise the robustness and reproducibility of embedding-based analyses across acquisition settings. Stain normalisation is widely used to mitigate such colour variation, yet whether it improves retrieval with modern self-supervised pathology encoders remains unclear. We test whether stain normalisation improves cross-scanner and cross-staining image retrieval using the PLISM whole-slide image subset, comprising 13 co-registered images of serial sections prepared under different staining conditions and digitised using seven scanners (91 whole-slide images). We sample 400 matched locations across the 91 images, yielding 36,400 tile instances. We compare two DINOv2-based encoders, Phikon-v2 (1,024-dimensional) and Midnight-12k (3,072-dimensional), with Reinhard and Macenko normalisation against an unnormalised baseline. Performance is measured using paired top-1 nearest-neighbour retrieval accuracy in two settings: cross-scanner retrieval of the same physical section digitised by different scanners, and cross-staining retrieval across co-registered images of serial sections, which differ in staining condition and may also contain section-level morphological variation. Neither normalisation method consistently improves top-1 retrieval relative to no normalisation, while Macenko reduces accuracy by up to 18.3 percentage points. An exploratory UMAP of unnormalised Midnight-12k slide-level mean embeddings showed partial overlap between scanner groups in a two-dimensional projection. These results challenge the routine use of stain normalisation in foundation-model retrieval pipelines and support validating preprocessing choices for each encoder and retrieval setting.

summary.takeaway: 在使用现代自监督病理编码器的检索任务中，染色归一化并未稳定提升跨扫描仪与跨染色匹配定位检索精度，Macenko甚至最多降低18.3个百分点。
summary.methods: 使用PLISM WSI子集（13张共配准图像、7种扫描仪、91张WSI），采样400个匹配位置得到36,400个图块；比较DINOv2-based的Phikon-v2（1024维）与Midnight-12k（3072维）在Reinhard、Macenko归一化与无归一化基线下的成对top-1最近邻检索准确率，并对未归一化嵌入做探索性UMAP。
summary.relevance: 直接评估病理预训练编码器的鲁棒性与预处理选择，属于预训练模型在下游检索中的可靠性研究。
summary.caveat: 结论基于单一WSI子集与两种归一化方法及两种编码器，不能推广为所有染色归一化或编码器均无效；探索性UMAP为二维投影，非严格定量证据。

papers.title: Genomic foundation models do not yet boost common variant discovery beyond standard functional annotations
papers.abstract: Genomic foundation models (GFMs) use large-scale AI to model genetic sequences and their influence on molecular phenotypes. While GFMs have shown promise in rare variant analysis, their utility for common variant discovery remains untested. Using the surrogate functional false discovery rate framework for functionally informed GWAS discovery, we compared standard functional annotations (baselineLD) with annotations derived from three leading GFMs: the sequence-to-function models AlphaGenome and Borzoi, and the genomic language model GPN-Star. Across 27 UK Biobank traits, GPN-Star decreased locus discovery relative to a standard GWAS, whereas AlphaGenome and Borzoi increased discovery but by less than baselineLD (medians 1.8%, 3.8%, and 5.1%). When we combined the GFM and baselineLD annotations, there was no increase over baselineLD alone (median changes -0.1% to 0.2%), suggesting that AlphaGenome and Borzoi mostly capture information already in baselineLD. Thus, GFMs may require larger corpora or trait-specific feature engineering to improve discovery beyond standard functional annotations.

summary.takeaway: 在27个UK Biobank性状上，基因组基础模型注释未能超越标准功能注释baselineLD以促进常见变异发现，AlphaGenome与Borzoi的提升幅度更小且与baselineLD组合后无额外增益。
summary.methods: 采用功能性信息GWAS发现的功能性错误发现率（sfFDR）框架，比较baselineLD与三种GFM注释：序列到功能模型AlphaGenome、Borzoi及基因组语言模型GPN-Star，并评估GFM与baselineLD联合注释的效果。
summary.relevance: 该研究检验基因组基础模型预训练表征在下游遗传发现任务中的实际效用，直接关联预训练主题中基础模型价值评估。
summary.caveat: 结论限于常见变异与27个UK Biobank性状及所测试的三种GFM；不能排除更大语料或性状特异特征工程带来改进的可能，摘要未提供效应量置信区间等细节。

papers.title: Evolution of predator foraging in response to prey infection favors species coexistence
papers.abstract: As acknowledged by optimal foraging theory, predator diets depend on prey profitability. Parasites, affecting prey within food webs, are known to affect simultaneously host vulnerability to predation and host energy contents, thereby affecting profitability. In this work, we study the eco-evolutionary consequences of prey infection by a non trophically-transmitted parasite, with a simple lifecycle, on predator diet. We also analyse the consequences for coexistence between prey, predators and parasites. We model a trophic module with one predator and two prey species, one of these prey being infected by a parasite, and distinguish two effects of infection: a decrease in host fecundity (virulence effect) and an increase in vulnerability to predation (facilitation effect). Predator foraging may evolve toward specialist or generalist strategies, the latter being less efficient on a given resource. We show that virulence effects lead to specialisation on the non-infected prey while facilitation effects, by increasing prey profitability, favor specialisation on the infected prey. Combining the two effects at intermediate intensities promotes either generalist predators or the diversification of foraging strategies (coexistence of specialists), depending on the trade-off shape. We then investigate how the evolution of predator diet affects the niche overlap between predator and parasite. Facilitation effects systematically lead to a high niche overlap, ultimately resulting in the loss of the parasite. Virulence effects conversely favor coexistence by allowing a separation of the predator and parasite niches.

summary.takeaway: 食饵感染通过毒力效应与促进被捕食效应改变捕食者觅食策略演化，进而影响食饵、捕食者与寄生虫的共存结局。
summary.methods: 构建含一个捕食者和两个食饵物种的营养模块模型，其中一个食饵被非营养传递寄生虫感染；区分降低宿主繁殖力的毒力效应与提高被捕食脆弱性的促进效应，分析捕食者觅食策略（专化或泛化）的演化及权衡形状对共存的影响。
summary.relevance: 该文为生态演化建模，与检索增强与对齐主题无直接方法学关联，匹配可能来自泛化的模型分析或对齐概念。
summary.caveat: 为理论模型研究，结论依赖模型假设与权衡函数形式；摘要未给出参数范围或实证验证，难以直接外推到真实生态系统。

papers.title: Heatwaves and turbidity influxes have interacting and lasting effects on the foraging behaviour of three-spined stickleback Gasterosteus aculeatus
papers.abstract: Freshwater ecosystems support a disproportionately high share of fish species and biodiversity yet are among the most threatened ecosystems globally and are increasingly being exposed to multiple, co-occurring environmental stressors. In addition, predicting the combined impacts of environmental stressors remains a major challenge, particularly when stressors differ in how quickly they arise and how long their effects persist. Understanding how these stressors interact across time is critical for predicting their ecological consequences. Here, we examine how warming and turbidity, two widespread and intensifying stressors, interact to influence predator-prey dynamics in the three-spined stickleback (\textit{Gasterosteus aculeatus}). Using a fully factorial experiment, fish were exposed to ambient, warmed, turbid, or combined conditions for short (one week) or prolonged (six weeks) periods, before feeding rates were quantified across prey densities using a novel stochastic Bayesian model. We found that foraging behaviour was shaped primarily by prior exposure rather than the immediate experimental conditions. Short-term exposure to both stressors increased feeding rates, whereas prolonged warming reduced them. In contrast, turbidity continued to increase feeding rates over both time periods and, when combined with warming, offset the negative effects of extended heat exposure. Changes in feeding performance at the individual level may propagate through food webs, potentially triggering trophic cascades that reduce biodiversity. Given the exceptional biodiversity of freshwater systems, such dynamics are of particular concern. We also found that behavioural changes persisted even after stressors were removed, indicating that exposure history can have lasting effects. These findings suggest that short-term experiments, such as the functional response, may actually be measuring subject experiential history rather than responses to specific experimental conditions.

summary.takeaway: 热浪与浊度对三刺鱼觅食行为的影响取决于先前暴露史而非即时实验条件，短期双重胁迫提高摄食率，长期变暖降低摄食率，而浊度可抵消长期热暴露的负面效应。
summary.methods: 采用全因子实验，将鱼暴露于常温、变暖、浑浊及组合条件一周或六周，随后在不同猎物密度下量化摄食率，并使用新的随机贝叶斯模型分析。
summary.relevance: 该文为生态生理与行为实验，与检索增强与对齐主题无直接方法学关联。
summary.caveat: 结论基于单一物种与实验室条件，摘要未报告效应量；作者指出短期功能反应实验可能测量的是个体暴露历史而非特定条件反应，外推至野外食物网需谨慎。

papers.title: Super-Resolution Processing Enables In Situ Subtomogram Averaging Beyond the Nyquist Limit
papers.abstract: In situ subtomogram averaging (STA) for high-resolution structure determination requires fine pixel sampling, forcing a trade-off between achievable resolution and the field of view (FOV) recorded in each tomogram. Electron-event representation (EER) data can be rendered at half the physical pixel size, but whether super-resolution processing can recover useful information beyond the physical Nyquist limit from noisy in situ data remains unclear. Here, we show that super-resolution processing of EER data recovers biologically interpretable information beyond a physical Nyquist limit of 4.78 A in two in situ datasets. STA of unidentified virus particles in a Drosophila melanogaster larva yielded a 3.42 A inner capsid reconstruction, enabling de novo model building and identification of the particles as Drosophila A virus. In situ STA of ribosomes in Saccharomyces cerevisiae reached 3.18 A, with local resolution extending to 2.78 A. EER acquisition therefore provides greater flexibility in choosing the acquisition magnification: existing datasets can be re-rendered at the super-resolution pixel size when physical sampling becomes limiting, while lower-magnification acquisition can be considered when a larger FOV improves target capture or cellular context.

summary.takeaway: EER数据的超分辨处理可在物理Nyquist极限之外恢复可解释信息，使原位子断层平均在两个数据集中突破4.78 Å的物理采样极限。
summary.methods: 对EER数据进行超分辨渲染与处理，对果蝇幼虫中原位未识别病毒颗粒进行STA，并对酿酒酵母核糖体进行原位STA，评估重建分辨率与局部分辨率。
summary.relevance: 涉及成像数据的超分辨处理与高分辨率重建方法，与检索增强与对齐主题关联较弱，可能仅涉及数据处理流程。
summary.caveat: 仅展示两个原位数据集；超分辨恢复信息的普适性、对噪声与数据量的依赖未在摘要中量化说明。

papers.title: mixKIN: An ancestry-aware kinship estimation method for low coverage genomes
papers.abstract: Genetic kinship analysis provides insights into the social and biological organization of past populations. However, kinship estimation from low-coverage genomes, which are common in ancient DNA (aDNA) studies, remains challenging, particularly in genetically heterogeneous or admixed populations. Approaches that assume a homogeneous background relatedness can bias estimates when individuals have distinct ancestry. We developed mixKIN, an ancestry-aware kinship estimation from low-coverage genomes. Rather than using a single mismatch baseline for all pairs, mixKIN estimates pair-specific baseline by weighting within-population diversity and between-population divergence according to ancestry proportions of both individuals in each pair. We compared mixKIN with correctKin and RelateAdmix, which account for population structure and admixture, and with READv2 representing a widely used approach that assumes a homogeneous population background. To benchmark the methods, we ran extensive pedigree simulations across diverse demographic scenarios, including distant-population admixture, intra-population heterogeneity, and genetic outliers, at coverages from 1x to 0.03x. mixKIN achieved higher average classification performance in admixed and heterogeneous scenarios, while maintaining comparable performance in homogeneous populations, with relationships evaluated up to third-degree. In an application to an empirical data from a medieval English cemetery, mixKIN recovered relationships involving an individual with West African and European ancestries without the need for a manual adjustment to account for admixture. These findings support ancestry-aware mismatch normalization as a practical approach to improving kinship estimation and retaining genetically diverse individuals in kinship studies.

summary.takeaway: mixKIN通过按两个体祖先比例加权群体内多样性与群体间分化来估计配对特异性错配基线，在混合与异质人群中提升低覆盖基因组的亲缘关系分类性能。
summary.methods: 开发祖先感知的亲缘估计方法mixKIN，与correctKin、RelateAdmix及假设同质背景的READv2比较；在1x至0.03x覆盖度、远群体混合、群体内异质与遗传离群等场景下进行系谱模拟基准，并应用于中世纪英格兰墓地实证数据。
summary.relevance: 涉及低覆盖基因组数据的统计建模与基准比较，与检索增强与对齐主题仅间接相关。
summary.caveat: 性能优势主要见于混合与异质场景，同质人群仅保持可比；评估至三级亲缘关系，摘要未给出各场景具体数值与不确定性，实证应用为单个墓地案例。

papers.title: PigGPA: A Domain-Constrained Agent for Porcine Genomic Breeding with Verifiable Tool Execution
papers.abstract: Large language model agents can plan and execute scientific analyses, but successful task completion does not establish whether analytical decisions remain consistent across independent sessions or whether computations follow the parameters specified beforehand. We investigated these limitations using four genomic analysis tasks. General-purpose agents showed limited consistency in analytical decisions across repeated sessions (57.5-58.8%). Incorporating domain knowledge improved analytical performance, with reusable skills increasing mean evaluation scores from 73.44 to 89.06/100 , but did not resolve decision variability or ensure agreement between specified and executed parameters. To address these limitations, we developed an approach combining domain-constrained analytical skills with call-level execution contracts. Each tool invocation is linked to a pre-execution parameter declaration through SHA-256 hashing, with actual command-line arguments and execution records subsequently checked against the declared parameters. We implemented this approach in PigGPA, an autonomous agent for porcine genomic breeding that integrates statistical genetics, sequence-based functional prediction and multi-omics annotation. PigGPA completed all benchmark tasks with full agreement between declared and executed parameters, while its core quantitative-genetic results closely matched established software (r = 0.999-1.000). An application to loin muscle depth further demonstrated an integrated workflow from genetic association analysis to functional interpretation. These findings show that domain knowledge improves analytical performance, while direct verification of tool execution provides an additional basis for reproducible scientific computation.

summary.takeaway: 提出将领域约束分析技能与调用级执行契约相结合的LLM代理方法，并在猪基因组育种代理PigGPA中实现，使声明参数与实际执行参数完全一致。
summary.methods: 在四个基因组分析任务上比较通用代理的重复会话一致性；用SHA-256哈希将每次工具调用与执行前参数声明绑定，再核对命令行参数与执行记录；PigGPA整合统计遗传学、基于序列的功能预测和多组学注释，并与既有软件结果比较。
summary.relevance: 直接关联大语言模型主题，关注LLM代理在科学计算中的可重复性与工具执行验证。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告四个基准任务及猪育种单一应用场景，未说明任务选取的代表性、跨其他领域的外推能力或执行契约带来的额外开销。

papers.title: Relational Graph Convolutional Networks for Glioblastoma Biomarker Discovery via ceRNA and Copy Number Variation Analysis
papers.abstract: Glioblastoma (GBM) is a highly aggressive brain tumor with a five-year survival rate of 6.9%, attributable in substantial part to the shortage of reliable biomarkers. Competing endogenous RNA (ceRNA) and copy number variation (CNV) analyses each carry biomarker-identification potential, but existing work treats them separately and does not integrate multiple regulatory mechanisms. We therefore applied relational graph convolutional networks (RGCNs) to ceRNA and CNV knowledge graphs under a late-fusion ensemble architecture. Across 10-fold cross-validation the RGCN discriminated best among the graph architectures tested (AUCROC 0.874 {+/-} 0.070), significantly exceeding graph convolutional, graph attention and relational attention networks. Combining the ceRNA and CNV branches at the decision level gave the best overall performance (AUCROC 0.883 {+/-} 0.072; PR-AUC 0.208 {+/-} 0.152) and improved on the ceRNA-only model in precision--recall terms, although that improvement does not survive correction for multiple comparisons and we therefore report it as suggestive. Screening the late-fusion ranking against the existing glioma literature left five candidates that are absent from the curated glioblastoma biomarker set and the subject of at most one prior glioma report, among them hsa-miR-203b and hsa-miR-5683, each differentially expressed by more than fivefold on a log_2 scale. All five are computational predictions. Relational graph learning over a ceRNA network, combined with genomic dosage at the decision level, is thus a workable framework for biomarker prioritization, and the five loci give targeted experimental work a place to start.

summary.takeaway: 在ceRNA与CNV知识图谱上应用关系图卷积网络并以晚期融合集成，用于胶质母细胞瘤生物标志物优先级排序，并给出五个待实验验证的计算候选。
summary.methods: 构建ceRNA和CNV知识图谱，比较RGCN与GCN、GAT、关系注意力网络，采用10折交叉验证和决策级晚期融合；将排序结果与现有胶质瘤文献及 curated 生物标志物集比对。
summary.relevance: 关联知识图谱主题，展示图学习在生物医学知识图谱上的生物标志物发现应用。
summary.caveat: 融合模型相对ceRNA单模型的精确率-召回率提升未通过多重比较校正，仅属提示性；五个候选均为计算预测，未经实验验证，且附带效应量较大但需独立确认。

papers.title: NeuroPilot: Longitudinal intravital neural imaging across scales and modalities through an agentic platform
papers.abstract: Longitudinal intravital imaging is essential for understanding how neural populations evolve across behavioral states, yet converting large-scale recordings into biological insight remains a fundamental challenge because neural signals are degraded by noise, non-rigid motion, and heterogeneous recording conditions. Here we introduce NeuroPilot, an agentic framework that transforms neural imaging analysis into a closed-loop, context-aware process, integrating a multimodal large language model with callable computational imaging modules to adaptively coordinate workflows from raw recordings to population-level readouts. Across heterogeneous imaging and experimental regimes, NeuroPilot restores motion-degraded recordings and supports consistent neural signal recovery, detection, and tracking in challenging deep-brain, freely moving, and longitudinal settings. These enable neuronal population tracking across spinal stimulation paradigms, deep-brain imaging, and continuous 24-hour mPFC recordings aligned with spontaneous sleep-wake behavior. By converting heterogeneous intravital recordings into stable population activity maps, NeuroPilot supports behavioral decoding and reveals structured neural dynamics across behavioral states and transitions. NeuroPilot establishes a scalable agentic paradigm for neural imaging analysis, expanding experimental access to the measurement, visualization, and interpretation of neural population activity.

summary.takeaway: 提出NeuroPilot代理框架，将多模态大语言模型与可调用计算成像模块结合，把神经成像分析组织为闭环、上下文感知流程。
summary.methods: 集成多模态LLM与可调用计算成像模块，在多种成像与实验条件下处理噪声、非刚性运动及异质记录，完成运动校正、信号恢复、检测与追踪，并用于脊髓刺激、深脑成像和24小时mPFC记录。
summary.relevance: 同时关联大语言模型与多模态学习，体现代理式多模态系统在生物成像分析中的工作流协调。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出量化性能指标或与现有方法的系统比较，也未说明失败模式、计算成本及在不同实验室数据上的泛化程度。

papers.title: A Mechanistic Theory Unifying Value and Schema in the Prefrontal Cortex
papers.abstract: Animals exhibit behavioural flexibility by making reward-optimal decisions in unfamiliar situations. Computing value from minimal reward feedback requires leveraging known structure in the world. The Prefrontal Cortex (PFC) plays a pivotal role in both value computation and learning world structure, however mechanistic explanations for each---within the frameworks of Reinforcement Learning and Cognitive Maps---are largely distinct. We develop a mechanistic model of PFC that unifies value and structure through behavioural flexibility. In this model, value acts as a control signal that gates structured working memory representations of the current context in order to ultimately control behaviour. This is a significant departure from the conventional perspective of value, in which it is used for action readout. Critically, this model generalises to novel contexts without the need for additional synaptic plasticity. We demonstrate that recurrent neural networks (RNNs) meta-trained with either reinforcement learning or supervised learning recapitulate this exact model on various value-based tasks. These results not only provide a parsimonious explanation of both the value and schema frameworks of PFC function, but also propose a new mechanistic interpretation of the role of PFC in flexible decision making.

summary.takeaway: 提出一个机制模型，将PFC中的价值计算与结构化世界模型统一：价值作为控制信号门控当前情境的工作记忆表征，而非直接用于动作读出。
summary.methods: 构建机制模型并在多种价值任务上训练；用强化学习或监督学习元训练的循环神经网络复现该模型行为，检验其无需额外突触可塑性即可泛化到新情境。
summary.relevance: 关联强化学习与检索增强/对齐主题，涉及PFC功能、价值学习与结构化表征的机制解释。
summary.caveat: 摘要为理论与计算建模结果，未提供实验神经数据验证；模型的生物学可实现性及对更复杂任务的适用性未在摘要中说明。

papers.title: Single-cell transcriptomic analysis reveals autophagy-associated transcriptional vulnerability of dopaminergic neurons after atrazine exposure.
papers.abstract: Atrazine (ATZ) is a widely used triazine herbicide with potential neurotoxic effects, but the cell-type-specific responses of midbrain dopaminergic neurons to ATZ exposure remain poorly defined. In this study, we applied single-cell RNA sequencing to midbrain tissues from adult male mice exposed to ATZ for 28 days (a sub-acute exposure) to characterize transcriptional alterations associated with dopaminergic neuronal injury. Three mice per group were used for scRNA-seq, and group comparisons were performed using one-way ANOVA followed by Tukey's post hoc test, or the Kruskal-Wallis test with Dunn's post hoc test for non-normally distributed data. ATZ exposure reshaped the transcriptional profile of dopaminergic neurons and induced the activation of dopamine-related genes involved in dopamine synthesis, vesicular transport, reuptake, and receptor signaling, including Th, Slc18a2, Slc6a3, and Drd2. Programmed cell death module scoring revealed a significant increase in autophagy-associated signatures after ATZ exposure. Subpopulation analysis further showed that substantia nigra pars compacta dopaminergic neurons exhibited stronger programmed cell death and autophagy-related responses than ventral tegmental area dopaminergic neurons, indicating selective vulnerability within the midbrain dopaminergic system. Pseudotime trajectory analysis suggested a dynamic transition from dopamine-related gene activation to increased autophagy-related gene expression and altered neuronal state. Gene regulatory network inference computationally inferred a putative Th-Atg5 regulatory relationship linking dopaminergic functional disturbance with autophagy-associated signatures. Immunofluorescence validation confirmed increased Slc18a2 and LC3B expression in dopaminergic neurons, particularly in the substantia nigra pars compacta. These findings provide single-cell evidence that ATZ exposure is associated with a region-selective transcriptional vulnerability characterized by activation of dopamine-related genes, autophagy-associated vulnerability, and regional heterogeneity, offering new insight into the neurotoxic mechanisms of environmental herbicide exposure.

summary.takeaway: 利用单细胞RNA测序发现，阿特拉津暴露与中脑多巴胺能神经元中多巴胺相关基因激活及自噬相关转录脆弱性相关，且黑质致密部比腹侧被盖区更敏感。
summary.methods: 对暴露28天的成年雄性小鼠中脑组织进行scRNA-seq，每组3只；进行差异表达、程序性细胞死亡模块评分、亚群分析、拟时序轨迹和基因调控网络推断，并用免疫荧光验证Slc18a2与LC3B。
summary.relevance: 关联GRN/Regulon主题，包含基因调控网络推断及细胞类型特异性转录响应分析。
summary.caveat: 每组仅3只小鼠，属亚急性单一剂量暴露；Th-Atg5调控关系为计算推断，需实验验证；结论主要基于关联性转录证据。

papers.title: Cognitive cartography of mammalian brains using meta-analysis of AI experts
papers.abstract: No individual mind can fully grasp the complexity of modern neuroscientific literature. Where human experts flag, the latest AI models excel. Here we show how frontier large language models can systematically and quantitatively summarise literature-wide neuroscientific knowledge about the cognitive functions and dysfunctions associated with each brain region. Meta-analysis of these AI experts reveals structure-function mappings to which existing meta-analytic frameworks are blind, demonstrated by causal manipulations including lesions and intracranial stimulation. It also unlocks the possibility of extending quantitative literature meta-analysis and decoding of brain maps to other model organisms beyond human. As proof-of-concept, we integrate LLM meta-analysis with species-specific transcriptomics and connectomics in human, macaque, and mouse, discovering that the human molecular circuit for cognition is evolutionarily conserved. Altogether, literature synthesis with AI experts can fundamentally catalyze neuroscientific discovery by overcoming the barrier of data aggregation from heterogeneous studies, finally bringing together a scattered literature to identify latent insights across disparate subfields, modalities, and species.

summary.takeaway: 展示前沿大语言模型可系统定量汇总文献中脑区与认知功能/功能障碍的映射，并整合物种特异性转录组与连接组数据。
summary.methods: 对AI专家进行文献元分析，构建脑区-功能映射；结合病变和颅内刺激等因果操作证据；将LLM元分析与人、猕猴和小鼠的转录组及连接组整合。
summary.relevance: 直接关联大语言模型主题，体现LLM用于跨文献知识聚合与脑图谱解码。
summary.caveat: 摘要未量化LLM提取的准确性或与人类专家标注的一致性；结论依赖文献覆盖偏差及模型自身偏差，跨物种保守性推断需独立验证。

papers.title: muDM: A Queryable Multi-Resolution Data Model for Vector Geometry in Spatial Bioimaging
papers.abstract: Spatial bioimaging combines raster imagery with vector geometries that encode molecular measurements, connectivity, and anatomical labels. A major challenge is to connect and jointly query these resources at scale, because the vector structures that locate them cannot be searched across resolutions. muDM is a spatial data model for associating vector geometry with its annotated records. Under a single schema, it arranges 2D and 3D geometries, together with their identities and measurements, as a precomputed multi-resolution pyramid, a columnar store that can be queried in place from object storage and equivalent render-ready tiles from the same index. Deployed in a public catalog containing more than 100 datasets, this single model supports connectome meshes, multiplexed tissue imaging, and spatial transcriptomics. For neuron meshes, classifiers which use geometry together with linked synapse counts exceed the performance of geometry-only models, while coarser levels preserved most balanced accuracy and using up to two orders of magnitude less stored geometry.

summary.takeaway: 提出muDM空间数据模型，在单一模式下将2D/3D向量几何及其注释记录组织为可查询的多分辨率金字塔，并支持对象存储原地查询与渲染瓦片。
summary.methods: 构建预计算多分辨率金字塔与列式存储，统一管理几何、身份和测量；在含100多个数据集的公共目录中支持连接组网格、多重组织成像和空间转录组；用结合几何与突触计数的分类器评估。
summary.relevance: 关联检索增强与对齐主题，涉及大规模空间生物成像数据的高效检索与多分辨率查询。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告在公共目录中的部署与分类评估，未说明查询延迟、存储开销的完整基准或与其他空间数据模型的系统对比。
